macros.name: Halfspace
macros.doc: The \Halfspace command produces the elastic horizontal space and its *-form produces the nonbreakable elastic space.

macros.name: Halfspace*
macros.doc: The \Halfspace command produces the elastic horizontal space and its *-form produces the nonbreakable elastic space.
